Reach out — discover your next sound bath

We hold intentionally small, sensory-forward sound experiences in {{CITY}}, {{STATE}}. Whether you want to join a public circle, reserve a private 1:1, or learn about membership privileges, we’ll guide you to the right container.

Short diagnostic

Not sure where to begin? Use the quick cues below so we can suggest the best format for your needs.

  • Primary aim: calm, sleep support, emotional release, or workplace restoration
  • Preferred intimacy: open circle vs. private session
  • Any sensory or mobility considerations?

How a gathering is planned

We design each event with layered intention: arrival, immersion, and subtle reentry.

Welcome

Slow arrival, scent-free check-in, guidance on props.

Sound immersion

Blended tones: crystal bowls, tuning forks, and a wooden monochord for sustained body resonance.

Integration

Tea, journaling prompts, and gentle sharing if desired.

Contact & bookings

Call or email to secure a seat, ask about memberships, or request a tailored corporate session.

Phone: {{PHONE}}
Email: {{EMAIL}}

Book online

Location

We rotate intimate venues; many gatherings take place at {{VENUE_NAME}} in {{CITY}}. Exact address shared after booking.

What to bring

Comfort deepens the experience. Bring:

  • Comfortable mat, blanket, and a bolster or pillow
  • Eye covering for gentle darkness
  • Reusable water bottle and an openness to rest

Contraindications & safety

While sound baths are gentle, please consult with a medical professional and inform the facilitator before attending if you have epilepsy, severe cardiovascular issues, recent head injury, or are in early pregnancy.

Typical session flow

A standard session (60–90 minutes):

  1. Settling & orientation (10–15 min)
  2. Layered sound immersion (35–60 min) — instruments attuned to encourage nervous system downregulation
  3. Soft reorientation & tea (10–15 min)

Instruments we may use

Our palette varies with intention: crystal singing bowls, a deep gong, koshi-style chimes, tuning forks, and a resonant monochord are examples.

Micro-practices

5-minute breath anchor
Nightly body scan before sleep
Weekly quiet hour — no screens

Rates snapshot

Private 1:1 session (60 min)

Memberships grant discounted access and priority booking. Ask about our membership model when you contact us.

Immediate questions?

Call or text {{PHONE}} or email {{EMAIL}}. We typically reply within 48 hours.
